title: Morning run record
content: At 2 p.m., she took the subway to the Toyota showroom on Gloucester Road, Wan Chai. Wearing anti-blue-light glasses, she carefully inspected the Prius display car's interior, space, and display screen. Sales consultant Mr. Wu introduced the fuel consumption, hybrid power principle, and 5-year warranty policy in detail, and prepared a formal quotation including government environmental incentives and an estimated trade-in subsidy. Yu Xiaowei noted down the key information and asked for a brochure, then sat in the driver's seat to check the view. As she was leaving, a sudden downpour hit. While sheltering at the showroom entrance, she ran into her high school classmate He Junjie, who happened to be in the area looking at cars. They chatted about recent news for 10 minutes, and He Junjie joked that next time there was a class reunion, he would invite her to bring more clients. When the rain eased, they said goodbye, and Yu Xiaowei took the subway home.
